description: Apple’s foldable iPhone may use a dual-layer glass design to reduce display creases, according to a recent leak. The setup is said to place the display between two thin glass layers, preventing direct contact with the hinge and improving durability. The device may also feature self-healing glass and a redesigned hinge to minimise wear and enhance folding smoothness. While unconfirmed, the leak suggests Apple is focusing on improving reliability and addressing key issues before entering the foldable smartphone segment.
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone Tipped to Feature New Glass Design That Might Reduce Display Crease

description: Apple was all over the news this month for its multiple product announcements. The company updated almost all product categories. The launch started with the anticipated iPhone 17e, equipped with the Apple A19 chip. The brand has also released the iPad Air featuring the M4 chip alongside the iPhone 17e. The MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models were also refreshed with the latest M-series chipsets. The company launched MacBook Neo and AirPods Max 2 as well. Here’s a detailed look at all the major products Apple released this month.
title: Everything Apple Launched in March: iPhone 17e, MacBook Neo, AirPods Max 2 and More

description: OnePlus 15T has been listed on the China Telecom website with the model number PLZ110. The listing reveals key specifications and design of the upcoming smartphone. Scheduled to be launched in China on Tuesday (March 24) by the tech firm. The listing suggests that the OenPlis 15T will be equipped with a 16-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls, housed inside a hole punch display cutout. It is confirmed to be offered in the country in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 256GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations.
title: OnePlus 15T  Surfaces in China Telecom Listing With Key Specifications and Design

description: Samsung is set to launch the Galaxy A37 and Galaxy A57 on March 25, with pricing leaked ahead of the announcement via a hands-on video. The Galaxy A37 may start at VND 10,990,000 (roughly Rs. 39,000), while the A57 could cost VND 12,490,000 (roughly Rs. 44,400), indicating a price increase over their predecessors. Both phones feature minor design changes and are expected to offer chipset upgrades, large 6.7-inch 120Hz displays, and 5,000mAh batteries. They may run Android 16 with long-term updates and retain similar camera setups.
title: Samsung Galaxy A37, Galaxy A57 Price Details Emerge in Hands-On Video Ahead of March 25 Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Wide Fold, and Galaxy Z Flip 8 have been listed on the China Compulsory Certification (3C) database with the model numbers SM-F9710, SM-F9760, and SM-F7760, respectively. The listings suggest that the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Wide Fold will support 45W wired fast charging, which is faster than the 25W charging on the Galaxy Z Fold 7. On the other hand, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 could retain 25W wired charging support.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Listing on Chinese Certification Database Seemingly Confirms Charging Upgrade

description: Huawei Mate 80 Pro Max Wind Edition has been launched in China. The new phone has a triple rear camera unit and a built-in cooling fan for thermal management. It features a 6.9-inch AMOLED LTPO display and runs on the Kirin 9030 Pro chipset. The Huawei Mate 80 Pro Max Wind Edition carries a 6,000mAh battery with support for 100W wired charging and 80W wireless charging.
title: Huawei Mate 80 Pro Max Wind Edition Launched With Built-In Cooling Fan, Three Rear Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: AI+ Nova 2 5G and Nova 2 Ultra 5G will launch on April 9 in India. The teaser image shared by the brand shows the Nova 2 Ultra 5G in Black, Blue, Green, Purple, and Red colours. The Nova 2 5G is teased in Black, Blue, Green, Pink and Purple shades. Both smartphones feature red-accented power buttons. The Ultra model will have a customised light interface on the rear panel.
title: AI+ Nova 2 5G, Nova 2 Ultra 5G Set to Launch in India on April 9; Design, Colours Teased

description: Apple Stores are seeing low stock of the Apple TV, HomePod and HomePod mini, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, sparking speculation about upcoming updates. While Apple has had new versions of the Apple TV and HomePod mini ready since last year, their release has reportedly been delayed due to pending Siri and Apple Intelligence upgrades. Stock shortages are most noticeable for the HomePod mini. Reports also suggest Apple could introduce a more advanced Siri in 2026, alongside hardware upgrades for its home devices.
title: Apple TV, HomePod and HomePod Mini Stock Reportedly Drops at Apple Stores Globally Ahead of Anticipated Upgrades

description: Huawei Enjoy 90 series has been launched in China by the smartphone maker. The new lineup, which includes the Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max and Huawei Enjoy 90 Plus, is scheduled to go on sale in the country via the tech firm’s website. The Enjoy 90 Plus is offered in Feather Sand White, Starry Night Black, and Starry Sea Blue colour options, while the Enjoy 90 Pro Max ships in Dawn Gold, Flying Azure, Obsidian Black, and Snow White colourways. Both phones are powered by Huawei’s proprietary Kirin 8000 chipset and run on the company’s HarmonyOS 6.0.
title: Huawei Enjoy 90 Plus, Enjoy 90 Pro Max Launched With Kirin 8000 Chip and 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Features

description: CoinDCX founders Sumit Gupta and Neeraj Khandelwal have been arrested by Thane police for allegedly being involved in a ₹71.6‑lakh fraud. Officials say the case links them to cheating through the crypto platform. However, the company claims the FIR is false and says impersonators pretended to be its founders to fool the public and create a conspiracy against CoinDCX.
title: Two Co-Founders of Crypto Exchange CoinDCX Held on Charges of Fraud

description: Poco X8 Pro 5G and Poco X8 Pro Max 5G are now available for purchase in India, the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Monday. The new Poco X series handsets are on sale in the country via Flipkart. The Poco X8 Pro 5G is offered in Black, Green, and White colourways, while the Poco X8 Pro Max 5G ships in Black, Blue, and White options. The Pro Max model is powered by a 3nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset, paired with a 9,000mAh battery. On the other hand, the Poco X8 Pro 5G is equipped with a 4nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC and a 6,500mAh cell.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series With Up to 9,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Apple is reportedly planning to refresh its entry-level iPad in the first half of 2026, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. The device is expected to launch around the iOS 26.4 cycle, possibly in April or May. The update will likely focus on a chip upgrade from A16 to A18, bringing improved performance and Apple Intelligence support. With higher-end iPads already updated, the refresh aims to align the base model with the rest of the lineup, while design changes are expected to remain minimal.
title: Apple's Entry-Level iPad with A18 Chip, Apple Intelligence Support Expected to Launch in H1 2026: Gurman

description: Realme 16 5G India launch will take place soon. The exact launch date is still under wraps, but it is confirmed to be available through Flipkart. It features a selfie mirror on the rear camera module that allows users to preview their shots in real time. It is teased to have a lightweight build and is shown in a white shade with a horizontal camera bar, resembling the design of the iPhone Air and Pixel 10 series smartphones.
title: Realme 16 5G With 50-Megapixel Rear Camera Set to Launch in India Soon via Flipkart

description: PBKReviews tears down the Galaxy S26 to examine its internals, offering a look at what the phone looks like from the inside. The teardown video starts with removing the SIM tray and the back plate. The back panel comes off after applying some heat to make the adhesive come off easily. The video notes that the glass camera lens covers can be replaced easily by applying heat. The rings can also be replaced.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Teardown Video Confirms the Smartphone Has a Repair-Friendly Design

description: Vivo V70 FE will be launched in India soon, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Monday. A dedicated microsite for the handset is now live on Amazon, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The upcoming Vivo V70 FE will be equipped with a 200-megapixel primary camera on the back with optical image stabilisation (OIS). It will carry a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module. While the company has yet to confirm the exact launch date, a tech blogger claims that the phone will be unveiled in India on April 2.
title: Vivo V70 FE India Launch Teased; Confirmed to Feature 200-Megapixel Camera

description: OnePlus is expected to expand its Ace 6 lineup with the Ace 6 Ultra, which may launch in China as early as April, following the OnePlus 15T debut on March 24. Leaks suggest it could feature a 6.8-inch display with a 165Hz refresh rate and run on the Dimensity 9500 chipset. The handset may have already cleared certification in China, while a possible model listing has surfaced on SRRC. It is likely to compete with the upcoming Redmi K90 Ultra.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Leak Hints at MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chip, 6.8-inch 165Hz Display

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra will be launched in select global markets in April, the Chinese tech firm confirmed on Monday. The handset will also be unveiled in China along with the Oppo Find X9s Pro. As part of the announcement, the smartphone maker has also teased the design of the Ultra model. The phone is shown to feature an unspecified orange button on the right side, which resembles Apple’s Camera control button, first introduced with the iPhone 16 series. This comes soon after Oppo confirmed that its Find X9 Ultra will be launched globally soon.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Global Launch Timeline Confirmed as Company Teases Find X9s Pro Debut

description: Oppo K14 Turbo and Oppo K14 Turbo Pro have been spotted on the TENAA certification database with the model numbers PMH110 and PMG110. A tipster claims that the two smartphones are expected to be launched in China next month. The listings on the certification website reveal key specifications of the two handsets, along with their design. The purported Oppo K14 Turbo is listed with a 6.59-inch AMOLED display with 1 billion colours. Both phones might carry triple rear camera units, led by 50-megapixel primary shooters.
title: Oppo K14 Turbo, Oppo K14 Turbo Pro Key Specifications and Design Spotted on Certification Database

description: Samsung has started rolling out an AirDrop-style file sharing feature on Galaxy devices, beginning with the Galaxy S26 series in South Korea. Integrated into Quick Share, the feature aims to improve cross-device and cross-platform file transfers. The rollout will expand to regions including Europe, North America and Southeast Asia in phases, with availability varying by market. Currently limited to the S26 lineup, Samsung plans to extend support to more devices later.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Gets AirDrop Support via Quick Share in South Korea Ahead of Global Expansion

description: Vivo X300 Ultra is confirmed to launch in China next week. Ahead of the official launch, a new leak suggests that the Vivo X300 Ultra and Oppo Find X9 Ultra will be more expensive than the Xiaomi 17 Ultra due to increasing storage costs. The Vivo X300 Ultra is expected to cost around CNY 7,500 (roughly Rs. 1,01,000) for the 12GB RAM and 512GB storage model. The Vivo X300 Ultra supports the new 400mm telephoto lens.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, Oppo Find X9 Ultra Prices Leaked; Could Be More Expensive Than Xiaomi 17 Ultra
